actions.action: Shake plant over white paper to distinguish whiteflies from aphids
Keep plants isolated and check leaf undersides and stems daily
Remove heavily infested leaves and bag them outside
Rinse plants with water spray focusing on leaf undersides
Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3 weeks
Place yellow sticky traps near plants

reason: The answer names whiteflies as the main cause and aphids only as a secondary possibility; the water rinse that fixed it is included but placed among treatments mainly aimed at whiteflies, and nothing it suggests would harm the plant.
